metadata.description: Knowz AI marketplace for Grok Build, Grok Bot, and Cursor: two separately installable plugins — Knowz (vault CLI/MCP) and KnowzCode (TDD quality-gate workflow with Grok-host process relay)

plugins.name: knowz
plugins.description: Knowz vaults via CLI or hosted MCP. Search, ask, save, browse, and amend team knowledge. Grok Build: grok plugin install knowz --trust. Grok Bot/Cursor: Add then Authorize. Install separately from KnowzCode.

plugins.name: knowzcode
plugins.description: TDD and quality-gate coding workflow with local handoffs and Grok-host process relay to Codex or Claude Code. Grok Build: grok plugin install knowzcode --trust. No MCP in this plugin — Knowz vaults are a separate optional install and never block work.
